results.label: sca
results.description: A Prototype Pollution vulnerability was discovered in lodash prior to 4.17.12, in lodash.defaultsdeep prior to 4.6.1, and in @sailshq/lodash prior to 3.10.4. The function 'defaultsDeep' allows a malicious user to modify the prototype of Object via '{constructor: {prototype: {...}}}' causing the addition or modification of an existing property that will exist on all objects.
